shortDescription: The SENSEX Index rose 138 points or 0.19 percent on Thursday to close at 74903 points.Leading the gains are Power Grid (1.94%), Bharti Airtel (1.12%) and Tech Mahindra (0.88%).Top losers were HCL Tech (-2.50%), Tata Steel (-1.51%) and Indusind Bank (-1.29%).
